scenarios.criterion: Closing a parked or stopped order with `loom factory close <order> --shipped-by <url>` appends exactly one `shipped` ledger entry carrying the URL in `url` and the approver — from the same source as `loom factory approve` — in `approvedBy`.
scenarios.name: Close a parked order records a shipped ledger entry
given: an order "reagent-map-visual-baselines" is parked in the ledger
when: the operator runs "loom factory close reagent-map-visual-baselines --shipped-by https://github.com/orieken/saturday-monorepo/pull/23"
then: the ledger gains exactly one new entry with phase "shipped"
that entry's "url" field holds "https://github.com/orieken/saturday-monorepo/pull/23"
that entry's "approvedBy" field holds the same approver identity that "loom factory approve" records

scenarios.criterion: Closing a parked or stopped order with `loom factory close <order> --shipped-by <url>` appends exactly one `shipped` ledger entry carrying the URL in `url` and the approver — from the same source as `loom factory approve` — in `approvedBy`.
scenarios.name: Close a stopped order records a shipped ledger entry
given: an order "order-x" is stopped in the ledger
when: the operator runs "loom factory close order-x --shipped-by https://github.com/example/repo/pull/1"
then: the ledger gains exactly one new entry with phase "shipped"
that entry's "url" field holds the given URL
that entry's "approvedBy" field holds the approver identity

scenarios.criterion: After that entry, `loom factory status` shows the order as `shipped` with the URL in its detail column, and `loom factory inbox` no longer lists it.
scenarios.name: Shipped order appears in status with its URL and drops out of the inbox
given: order "order-x" was just closed with "--shipped-by https://example.com/pr/1"
when: the operator runs "loom factory status"
the operator runs "loom factory inbox"
then: "loom factory status" lists order "order-x" with phase "shipped" and its detail column showing "https://example.com/pr/1"
"loom factory inbox" no longer lists order "order-x"

scenarios.criterion: An order whose `depends-on` names the closed order is claimed by the supervisor on its next pass, with no edit to either order.
scenarios.name: A dependent order is claimed once its dependency ships
given: order "order-y" has "depends-on: order-x"
order "order-x" is parked
when: the operator runs "loom factory close order-x --shipped-by https://example.com/pr/1"
the supervisor runs its next pass
then: the supervisor claims order "order-y"
neither order-x's nor order-y's definitions were edited

scenarios.criterion: Closing an order archives its run state and removes its worktree, in the same order as the supervisor's own ship: record the ledger line first, archive, then remove; if archiving fails, the worktree is kept and the command reports why.
scenarios.name: Closing archives the run state and removes the worktree in order
given: order "order-x" is parked with an active worktree
when: the operator runs "loom factory close order-x --shipped-by https://example.com/pr/1"
then: the shipped ledger entry is recorded before the run state is archived
the run state is archived before the worktree is removed
the worktree no longer exists afterward

scenarios.criterion: Closing an order archives its run state and removes its worktree, in the same order as the supervisor's own ship: record the ledger line first, archive, then remove; if archiving fails, the worktree is kept and the command reports why.
scenarios.name: A failed archive keeps the worktree and explains why
given: order "order-x" is parked
archiving the run state will fail
when: the operator runs "loom factory close order-x --shipped-by https://example.com/pr/1"
then: the shipped ledger entry is still recorded
the worktree is kept
the command reports the reason archiving failed

scenarios.criterion: `close` refuses an order that is running, retrying, waiting at a gate, waiting on a commit or PR approval, or already shipped, with exit code 1, the order's phase named, and an instruction to stop it first; the ledger does not change.

given: order "order-x" is running
when: the operator runs "loom factory close order-x --shipped-by https://example.com/pr/1"
then: the command exits with code 1
the message names the phase "running"
the message instructs the operator to stop the order first
the ledger is unchanged

scenarios.criterion: `close` never calls GitHub and never checks that the named pull request merged; the human running it vouches for that, and `approvedBy` records who.
scenarios.name: Closing trusts the human-provided URL without verifying the pull request
given: order "order-x" is parked
the pull request at the given URL has not actually merged
when: the operator runs "loom factory close order-x --shipped-by https://github.com/example/repo/pull/99"
then: the command completes without making any call to GitHub
the shipped ledger entry's "approvedBy" field records the operator who vouched for the merge

scenarios.criterion: `close` and the supervisor never both act on the same order: `close` reads the ledger fresh and validates the order's current phase before appending, the same TOCTOU-tolerant pattern `approve`, `stop` and `rerun` already use.
scenarios.name: close re-reads the ledger and refuses if the phase changed before it could append
given: order "order-x" was parked when the close command started
the supervisor transitions order "order-x" to "running" before close appends its entry
when: close re-reads the ledger and validates the order's current phase immediately before appending
then: close refuses the close because the order is no longer parked or stopped
the ledger is unchanged by the close attempt

scenarios.criterion: `templates/claude-feature-team/intake/README.md` documents when to use `close`: after an order parks and a person finishes the work in their own pull request, once that PR merges.
scenarios.name: The intake README documents when to use close
given: "templates/claude-feature-team/intake/README.md" exists
when: a person reads the README looking for guidance on closing an order
then: it explains that "close" is used after an order parks and a person finishes the work in their own pull request, once that PR merges
